title: STRENGTH FOR TODAY — Five-Year Doctrinal and Editorial Audit Framework

hierarchy.primary: The Bible is the final authority; the current Heavenly Key Statement of Faith defines the ministry's doctrinal boundaries.
secondary: Deeper Life Bible Church / Daily Manna devotional approach and Pastor W.F. Kumuyi's publicly available biblical teaching
Mountain of Fire and Miracles Ministries' publicly stated beliefs and scriptural prayer emphasis
hierarchy.conflictRule: Do not merge distinct denominational formulations or allow a secondary source to override Scripture or Heavenly Key's Statement of Faith. If a secondary source's particular formulation is not explicitly adopted by Heavenly Key, flag it for pastoral review rather than presenting it as Heavenly Key doctrine.

auditStandards.name: Heavenly Key Statement of Faith
principles: The Bible is final authority for faith, conduct and ministry.
The Father, Son and Holy Ghost are distinct and perfectly united in the Godhead.
Jesus Christ: virgin birth, sinless life, crucifixion, death, burial, bodily resurrection and coming again.
Human sin, genuine repentance, faith in Christ, salvation by God's grace and a transformed obedient life.
Restitution where wrongs can properly be corrected; consecrated holy living.
The present work and baptism of the Holy Spirit, power for Christian witness and gifts according to Scripture.
Redemption in Christ; prayer for healing, deliverance and wholeness according to Scripture.
Every Christian's call to compassionate personal evangelism and the Great Commission.
Biblical end-time hope; watchfulness, faithfulness and readiness for Christ's return.

auditStandards.name: Deeper Life / Daily Manna / Pastor W.F. Kumuyi
auditStandards.role: Doctrinal and devotional comparison standard; use verified public sermons and official church teaching, not copied devotional prose
principles: Scripture-centred exposition: the context and meaning of the passage govern the lesson.
Repentance and conversion must be genuine, not merely emotional regret or religious activity.
Justification and salvation rest on God's grace and Christ's atoning work, not human merit.
Holiness, sanctification, purity of heart and obedience must be treated seriously and biblically.
Restitution and a clear conscience where applicable.
The Holy Spirit's baptism, power and gifts must be presented with scriptural care and without teaching people to manufacture manifestations.
Healing, evangelism, marriage, Christ's return, resurrection, judgement, heaven and hell must not be contradicted or treated carelessly.
Daily application should arise naturally from the Scripture, with practical obedience, prayer and soul-winning rather than generic motivational filler.

auditStandards.name: Mountain of Fire and Miracles Ministries
auditStandards.role: Doctrinal and prayer comparison standard; use official published beliefs and public teaching
principles: Scripture is inspired and the basis for faith and fellowship.
The triune God, the fall of humanity and redemption through Christ's blood.
Salvation through Christ and the regenerative work of the Holy Spirit; sanctification as separation from evil.
Holy Spirit baptism, restitution where possible, water baptism and the Lord's Supper.
Divine healing through Christ; prayer for healing must not replace responsible medical care or promise guaranteed outcomes.
Rapture, second advent, millennial reign, final judgement and new heaven and earth.

Spiritual warfare must remain subject to Scripture, Christ's victory, truth, repentance and holy living; reject superstition, fear manipulation, vengeance, curses against people, formulaic guarantees or claims that a prayer phrase mechanically controls God.

perDayAudit: Daily topic is biblical, clear, specific, non-duplicative and suitable for its assigned date in the five-year progression.
All six KJV readings are exact, correctly referenced, contextually interpreted and split into three Old Testament and three New Testament readings.
The daily topic is supported by the readings; the Bible story is a faithful account of its passage and does not invent details.
The contemporary story is real, attributable, accurately sourced, date-appropriate, ethically presented and directly relevant; no fabricated testimony or unverified miracle claim.
Hymn title, number, wording and source are verified against the ministry's licensed/owned hymn collection; no invented hymn metadata or unlicensed full lyrics.
Eternity in View is consistent with biblical teaching on Christ's return, resurrection, judgement, heaven and hell.
Destiny Decision & Action calls for concrete biblical obedience, repentance, restitution, holiness, faith or evangelism as relevant; it does not teach salvation by works.
Warfare Prayer is Christ-centred and scriptural, not superstition, fear, revenge, manipulation or guaranteed outcomes.
Prophetic Prayer is a prayer, not an invented divine quotation, guaranteed prediction, or claim of revelation without substantiation.
Health & Wellness Prayer honours God's care and healing while not discouraging diagnosis, treatment or professional medical help.
Salvation Prayer clearly presents sin, repentance, grace, faith in Jesus Christ, His death and bodily resurrection; it does not imply a prayer formula alone saves.
All twelve Kingdom Challenges are distinct, practical, safe, measurable and connected to the day's teaching.

block: Contradiction of Scripture or Heavenly Key Statement of Faith
Misquotation or materially false interpretation of Scripture
Fabricated Bible narrative, testimony, miracle, source or prophecy
Manipulative spiritual threats, guaranteed healing/prosperity/deliverance, vengeance or superstition
Dangerous health instruction or discouraging appropriate medical care
major: Contradiction with a cited Deeper Life/Kumuyi or MFM doctrinal source requiring reconciliation
Unsupported contemporary story or hymn attribution
Repeated/templated content that undermines the daily lesson
editorial: Clarity, grammar, repetition, weak application, inaccessible wording or incomplete section

publicationRule: Every one of the 1,828 dates must have a completed per-day audit record, verified Scripture and source citations, documented corrections, and named human doctrinal/editorial approval before publication. Automated keyword checks are triage only and cannot grant doctrinal approval.
nonCopyingRule: Use the named ministries' published doctrine and teaching as audit references. Do not reproduce copyrighted Daily Manna entries, sermons or MFM devotional/prayer books; write original Heavenly Key material and cite factual sources.
